children: SalamAir, Oman’s low-cost carrier, commenced operations to Mogadishu, Somalia, today (September 3), introducing a new direct air link between the capitals of Oman and Somalia.

As Somalia’s capital and main commercial centre, Mogadishu’s addition to SalamAir’s network is expected to support business activity, family travel and increased business-to-business engagement, while creating a new travel corridor between Oman and East Africa.

Steven Allen, Chief Commercial Officer of SalamAir, said: “The launch of our direct service to Mogadishu represents a strategic expansion of SalamAir’s African network and strengthens our presence in East Africa. This new route is in response to growing demand for affordable connectivity and to support business and trade between Oman and Somalia. This connectivity provides passengers with convenient onward access through Muscat to destinations across our network and it also contributes to Oman Vision 2040 by strengthening the Sultanate’s international connectivity and contributing to economic diversification.”

title: ZAWYA: SalamAir inaugurates direct flights to Mogadishu- Somalia
